purpose: Cross-family Basic Five evaluation with released pretrained weights, a fully frozen backbone, and the minimum task-appropriate readout.
design_principle: Use one standard-inspired canonical recipe per task and apply it unchanged to every backbone. Preserve the pretrained representation and minimize trainable task-specific capacity.

global_rules.pretrained_weights: Use the released pretrained checkpoint as-is; no intermediate adaptation or task-specific pretraining.
global_rules.feature_layer: single canonical final pre-classifier feature layer; no learned layer mixing or model-specific layer search
global_rules.spatial_requirement: ADE20K and NYUv2 require spatial tokens or a spatial feature map; otherwise report UNSUPPORTED.
global_rules.hyperparameter_policy: No model-specific learning-rate sweep, feature selection, resolution change, or other tuning.
global_rules.precision: AMP/bfloat16 permitted; sensitive losses and metrics remain float32.

imagenet1k.input: train: random resized crop 224 and horizontal flip; evaluation: resize shorter side 256 and center crop 224; use published backbone normalization
imagenet1k.feature_and_pooling: canonical final global representation; L2-normalize before the classifier
imagenet1k.head: linear 1000-class classifier
imagenet1k.augmentation: random resized crop and horizontal flip only

coco.input: shorter side 800, longer side at most 1333; training horizontal flip p=0.5
coco.feature_and_pooling: preserve spatial/multiscale features; no global pooling
coco.head: FPN, RPN, RoIAlign, box classifier, and box regressor
coco.trainable_scope: complete Faster R-CNN/FPN detection head only; backbone frozen

optimization.schedule: step decay by 0.1 at epochs 8 and 11

ade20k.input: random scale [0.5, 2.0], random 224x224 crop, horizontal flip p=0.5; single-scale 224 evaluation
ade20k.feature_and_pooling: final spatial tokens reshaped to a 2-D grid; 1x1 Conv; bilinear upsampling with align_corners=false
ade20k.head: 1x1 Conv with 150 outputs

nyuv2.split: official Eigen-style 795 train / 654 test from labeled.mat and splits.mat
nyuv2.feature_and_pooling: final spatial tokens reshaped to a 2-D grid; 1x1 depth Conv; bilinear upsampling with align_corners=false
nyuv2.head: single-channel 1x1 Conv with positive depth parameterization
nyuv2.augmentation: baseline resize/crop and horizontal flip only

ssv2.input: 16 uniformly segmented frames; random within-segment training sample, segment-center evaluation sample; temporally consistent 224 crop; horizontal flip disabled
ssv2.feature_and_pooling: spatial mean per frame followed by temporal mean for image backbones; canonical final global representation for native video backbones
ssv2.head: linear 174-class classifier

optimization.gradient_accumulation: as needed to reach effective batch 256

ssv2.augmentation: temporally consistent random resized crop; no horizontal flip, Mixup, or CutMix

reporting.checkpoint_rule: Use the final scheduled epoch for the canonical score; do not select on the reported validation/test split.
reporting.seed_aggregation: Report every seed and mean plus standard deviation over seeds 0, 1, and 2.
reporting.unsupported_rule: Report UNSUPPORTED with a reason; never replace a task or feature type silently.
reporting.comparability_rule: Only untuned runs conforming to this file belong in the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 main table.

optional_tracks.ssv2_native_clip: native clip length or multi-view testing; report separately
